saucer.description: Keeps what you copy, images included, and drops them into an intake folder Kibble can sort.
saucer.empty: Nothing copied yet. Copy an image in a browser with right click and Copy Image, and it turns up here.
saucer.privacy: History is kept in memory only and never written to disk, because a clipboard ends up holding passwords sooner or later. Saving an image is the one thing here that writes anything.
saucer.status.off: Not watching. Nothing is being kept.
